text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, my cheeks and forehead are breaking 
out. I've been so busy lately that I've 
been neglecting my skincare, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I need to get plenty of rest, take my 
vitamins, and moisturize thoroughly...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Since I have the chance, maybe I'll 
try out all sorts of body care treatments!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I've been testing out organic cream 
imported from overseas, CICA samples from 
our partners, and serums from new 
brands...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's see the results... Oh? Is 
it still rough?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, did I try too many different things? 
I thought finding a good combination would 
turn into a business opportunity, but...
